newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Wheelock drops on lower interim profit.
newsitem.headline: Wheelock drops on lower interim profit.

text.p: Shares of Wheelock & Co Ltd fell HK$0.30 to a low of HK$21.50 before recovering slightly to HK$21.70 in late Wednesday trade after the company reported a 47.88 percent fall in net interim profit, analysts said.

"Investors are taking the results as an execuse to take profit since Wheelock has been rising sharply lately on expectation of better prospects for office buildings," said Lennon Chan, executive director of Tai Fook Securities.
The property and hotel operation group posted an interim net profit of HK$788 million for six months to September 30 against HK$1.51 billion a year earlier.
The figure fell below market expectations of between HK$800 million and HK$1.04 billion.
Chan said he saw immediate support for the shares at HK$21 before the market shrugged off the negative impact of the results.
Trading in Wheelock was moderate with 981,776 shares worth HK$21.27 million changing hands.
